title: Where is the company's ticket history?
prompt: A Designated Support Contact wants to see every ticket their company has opened. What should they do?

options.text: Open the support widget from Gleaniverse and select the Go to customer portal banner.
options.feedback: Correct. The banner appears in the Messages and Tickets sections. The portal recognizes identity only through the authenticated Gleaniverse path.

options.text: Bookmark ticket.glean.com and go there directly.
options.feedback: Not this one. The portal will not recognize the user's identity unless they arrive through the support widget.

options.text: Email help@glean.com and ask for a ticket export.
options.feedback: Not this one. Company-wide history is available directly in the customer portal.

takeaway: The Tickets section appears only after the first ticket is created.
